📢 9/23/26 FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING RESCHEDULED to 9/30/26

Due to unforeseen circumstances the Village Finance Committee Meeting is being rescheduled to next week. 📅 Wednesday, September 30, 2026 ⏰ NEW TIME: 7:15 PM Thank you for your understanding.
 
 

Public Notice of Vacancy on Village Council

The Village of Cleves has a vacancy on the Village Council and is seeking qualified residents who are interested in serving the Village. The application period has been extended. Interested individuals must submit a cover letter and resume to Village Administrator Justin Habig at justin.habig@clevesoh.gov by 12:00 p.m. on September 30, 2026. Materials may also be delivered in person to 92 Cleves Avenue by the stated deadline. Qualifications - Ohio Revised Code § 731.12 Pursua
 
 

Are You Prepared? Help Hamilton County Prepare for the Unexpected

Are you prepared for an emergency or disaster? We want to know. If you live or work in Hamilton County, Ohio, complete the Hamilton County Public Preparedness Survey. Your participation in this survey helps Hamilton County Emergency Management & Homeland Security Agency better meet your needs before, during, and after an emergency. Chevron Open House - 9/12/26

Chevron invites the community to an Open House at the former Gulf Refinery on Saturday, September 12, from 10:30 AM - 1:30 PM. Tours will run throughout the event, refreshments will be provided, and the public is welcome to attend.
 
 

♻️ GET IT TO THE CURB!♻️

Got an old TV collecting dust? A computer from the Windows XP era? An appliance that’s been “getting thrown away next weekend” for the last three years? This is your chance. Get it out of the house and GET IT TO THE CURB! The timing couldn’t be better. Reclaim that garage and basement before football season kicks off! Clear the clutter, make room for the TV, the cooler and the questionable amount of game-day food. 📅 Tuesday, September 15 & Wednesday, September 16, 2026 The V
 
 

NOTICE: 8/20/26 CLEAN COURT/BZA CANCELED

The Clean Court Board of Zoning Appeals (BZA) meeting scheduled for tonight, Thursday, August 20, 2026, has been canceled. There will be no Clean Court BZA meeting this evening. The Board will reconvene at its regularly scheduled September meeting. Village of Cleves
 
 

📢 FINANCE COMMITTEE MEETING – TIME CHANGE

Due to the Gravelrama Parade and associated road closures on Wednesday, August 26, the Village Finance Committee Meeting will have a delayed start time. 📅 Wednesday, August 26, 2026 ⏰ NEW TIME: 8:00 PM Previously scheduled for 6:30 PM The meeting will take place as scheduled, just a little later to allow the parade to conclude and traffic to clear. Thank you for your understanding, and enjoy the Gravelrama Parade!
